exit_criteria: STRICT self-governance specs and generated docs are synchronized.
Current main/branch/ruleset enforcement is audited and required remediation is recorded.
Existing governance execution has reproducible timing, scan-count, and CI baselines.
Known performance, documentation, sequence, and governance defects are recorded with evidence.
SW2-01 may begin only after SW2-00 acceptance evidence is complete.
phases.objective: Make Skill Workflow govern itself, establish exact current authority, capture performance and enforcement baselines, and define measurable V2 acceptance.
phases.title: Baseline & Self-Governance

exit_criteria: One canonical scan produces reusable facts for generators and validators.
Cache is acceleration only and cannot become acceptance authority.
Final acceptance proves governance parity with the pre-V2 contract.
Measured execution cost improves without skipping required gates.
phases.objective: Replace repeated scans and nested validator subprocess work with one immutable project snapshot and a dependency-aware validation DAG.
phases.title: Governance Engine V2

exit_criteria: Develop mode runs only safely impacted checks.
Verify mode expands to affected governance/test scope.
Finalize mode always executes the complete required acceptance graph.
Unknown impact fails closed to broader verification.
phases.objective: Introduce develop, verify, and finalize execution modes so inner-loop work is fast while final acceptance remains complete.
phases.title: Fast Development Workflow

exit_criteria: Full evidence graphs retain acceptance fidelity.
Human diagrams use semantic collapsing or subflows rather than raw helper dumps.
Mermaid syntax/render validation is blocking.
Diagram complexity thresholds are measurable and documented.
phases.objective: Separate full machine sequence evidence from bounded human-facing diagrams and add Mermaid correctness gates.
phases.title: Sequence V2

exit_criteria: README is a concise public landing page.
Concept, guide, reference, architecture, and sequence documentation have stable locations.
Machine indexes no longer dominate human-facing docs.
Generated documentation remains deterministic and drift-detectable.
phases.objective: Standardize public documentation information architecture and separate public guidance from machine indexes/evidence.
phases.title: Documentation System V2

exit_criteria: Profile/spec schemas have explicit versions.
Toolchain identity is lockable and auditable.
Supported migrations are deterministic and tested.
Release compatibility policy is documented.
phases.objective: Version project schemas, toolchain bundles, migrations, and compatibility guarantees.
phases.title: Schema & Toolchain Versioning

exit_criteria: Analyzer contract is language-independent.
Python and JS/TS remain fully regression-covered.
Generic fallback behavior is explicit and fail-safe.
Unsupported dynamic behavior remains NOT_PROVEN unless stronger evidence exists.
phases.objective: Introduce analyzer interfaces so structural evidence can grow beyond Python without coupling governance semantics to one parser.
phases.title: Cross-Language Analyzer Architecture

exit_criteria: Repository health files are present with Owner-approved license.
Security and contribution paths are documented.
Repository merge-governance boundary matches the explicit Owner decision, and any absence of platform enforcement is documented without false claims.
Release process is repeatable and evidence-backed.
phases.objective: Complete public repository health, security, contribution, and release governance.
phases.title: Public Project Hardening

exit_criteria: Representative LITE, STANDARD, and STRICT fixtures pass.
At least one large real consumer validates performance improvement and governance parity.
Migration regressions and false PASS cases are covered.
Cross-platform acceptance remains green.
phases.objective: Prove V2 against representative small and large consumer projects before declaring stability.
phases.title: Regression & Adoption Validation

exit_criteria: All prior SW2 phases are accepted.
Release candidate passes exact final acceptance.
Migration and rollback guidance are published.
A versioned GitHub release/tag is produced from the tested HEAD.
phases.objective: Publish the accepted V2 contract with migration documentation, compatibility guarantees, and exact release evidence.
phases.title: V2 Stable Release
